Tesla is offering select customers the opportunity to purchase its driverless Cybercab for personal use [1]. 

* The vehicle is priced at $29,990 [1].
* Operating the Cybercab requires a mandatory $299 per month Autonomy Subscription [1].
* Usage is currently limited to supported service areas in Texas and Florida [1].
